**What's the use case?**
What are you trying to do, and where does the current design get in the way?

**Proposed shape (optional)**
If you have a rough idea of the UI/data-model shape, sketch it here — no
need for a full spec.

**Does this cross the "pointers, not payloads" boundary?**
contex01 stores references to where things live, not the content itself. If
your request needs contex01 to host real content, say so explicitly — it
needs a deliberate scope decision.
